title: Vampire: The Masquerade – Chapters
subtitle: Narrative-driven RPG board game set in the World of Darkness
tagline: Embrace the shadows of Montreal and claim your immortal destiny
loreSummary: Set in Montreal following the fall of the Sabbat, you and your coterie of neonates must navigate deadly clan politics, mortal inquisitors, and ancient conspiracies lurking in the dark alleys of the Canadian metropolis.
keyFeatures: Branching, story-rich campaign with over 60 interconnected chapters
No Game Master required: seamless narrative storybook and dialogue trees
Deep character customization, clan disciplines, skill checks, and boons
Tactical combat, stealth investigation, and high-stakes social encounters

vtmchapters_standard.name: Standard Campaign Arc
vtmchapters_standard.description: The core storyline focusing on the primary coterie investigation, major clan clashes, and the main climax (~45 chapters).

vtmchapters_chronicle.name: Complete Montreal Chronicle
vtmchapters_chronicle.description: The thorough campaign experience pursuing every side investigation, character origin prologue, and branching alternative path (~60 chapters).

vtmchapters_expansions.name: Full Chronicle & Clan Expansions
vtmchapters_expansions.description: The ultimate narrative saga integrating the Ministry, Lasombra, Banu Haqim, and Hecata clan expansions into Montreal's dark web (~72 chapters).

milestones.title: Embraced in Montreal
milestones.phase: Phase I - Neonate Initiation & Coterie Formation
milestones.description: Completing character origin prologues, mastering basic disciplines, and forming the coterie amidst the shadows of Montreal.

milestones.title: The Investigation Deepens
milestones.phase: Phase II - Street Infiltration & Clue Gathering
milestones.description: Uncovering early evidence of a conspiracy, dealing with mortal authorities, and containing dangerous Masquerade breaches.

milestones.title: Court of the Camarilla
milestones.phase: Phase III - Elysium Politics & Elder Secrets
milestones.description: Navigating fragile alliances with clan elders, trading boons, and surviving political betrayal in Elysium.

milestones.title: Inquisition & Bloodfeud
milestones.phase: Phase IV - The Second Inquisition Purge
milestones.description: Confronting heavily armed mortal inquisitors and rooting out underground Sabbat remnants threatening total ruin.

milestones.title: The Night of Rebirth
milestones.phase: Phase V - Climax & The Fate of Montreal
milestones.description: The definitive clash deciding supremacy over Montreal, resolving personal story arcs and immortal destinies.
